# Huerta's Painting, LLC

> Family-owned residential painting company based in Apple Valley, Minnesota, serving the Twin Cities South Metro. Founded in 2018 by Pedro Ramirez-Huerta, who personally oversees each project. Fully registered and insured; workmanship guaranteed. Nextdoor Neighborhood Fave 2021–2025; BBB Accredited Business.

- Phone (call or text): (952) 769-3906
- Email: huertaspaintingllc@gmail.com
- Free in-home consultations and custom quotes
- Reviews: Google Business Profile, Nextdoor and Facebook (links on the site)

## Services

- [Interior Painting](https://huertaspaintingllc.com/services/interior-painting/): color consultation, materials selection, patching and priming, precision application.
- [Exterior Painting](https://huertaspaintingllc.com/services/exterior-painting/): cleaning, scraping, sanding, priming, even coverage.
- [Drywall Repair](https://huertaspaintingllc.com/services/drywall-repair/): nicks, cracks and damaged spots restored seamlessly.
- [Ceiling Texturing](https://huertaspaintingllc.com/services/ceiling-texturing/): popcorn removal and new textures.
- [Ceiling Repair](https://huertaspaintingllc.com/services/ceiling-repair/): water stains, peeling, cracking; patching to full replacement.
- [Deck Refinishing](https://huertaspaintingllc.com/services/deck-refinishing/): stripping, board replacement, sanding, moisture-repelling finish.

## Service area

- [Farmington](https://huertaspaintingllc.com/farmington-house-painting/)
- [Apple Valley](https://huertaspaintingllc.com/apple-valley-house-painting/)
- [Lakeville](https://huertaspaintingllc.com/lakeville-house-painting/)
- [Eagan](https://huertaspaintingllc.com/eagan-house-painting/)
- Also Burnsville, Rosemount, Eden Prairie, Richfield and Mendota Heights, MN.
